description: Fetch a sutta by id (e.g. "dn22", "mn1", "sn56.11") — the Pali root text of every segment. Pali only by default; pass langs for translations, translators to name a translator (e.g. ["en_sujato"]). Same data as dhamma.gift/api/text.

langs.description: Translation languages to include, e.g. ["ru","en"]. Default: none (Pali only).

suttaId.description: SuttaCentral-style id, e.g. dn22, mn1, sn56.11.

translators.description: Explicit translator keys, e.g. ["en_sujato"] to include Sujato.

name: get_text
